TARGET_AUDIENCE: Urban Indian parents aged 28–38 planning a multi-family or extended family hill-station getaway with young kids, who have saved countless foggy tea estate reels but keep stalling because everyone wants different things from the weekend.
PAIN_POINT: Six adults and two kids going to the Nilgiris: someone wants the 7:00 AM Doddabetta Peak sunrise, someone refuses to wake up early on vacation, and parents need to schedule around afternoon kid naps while securing Nilgiri Toy Train slots before they sell out. The family WhatsApp group has 80 unread messages and zero agreed itinerary.
CREATIVE_ANGLE: They know they want the crisp Nilgiri air, the heritage toy train, and a tea estate tour, but they do not know how to get six opinionated relatives and parents with kids to agree on daily timing without friction. Travafa's group trip planning lets everyone propose and vote on exact day-by-day activities—from the toy train slot to Doddabetta vs. Pykara Lake—turning endless group chat debates into a clear, voted-on plan in minutes.
LOOK_CONSTRAINTS: time_of_day: night, lit by artificial and practical lights; weather: just after rain, wet reflective surfaces; palette: warm earth tones, ochre and terracotta; film_look: clean modern digital capture, sharp; human_presence: one parent and one child, two people only
HOOK_STYLE: the character speaks straight to camera from the first frame, already mid-problem
PACING_SHAPE: compress the problem to the minimum needed to feel real; expand the product demonstration into the largest beat
ENDING_STYLE: the final part is a silent environment shot with no one in frame; the CTA overlay lands on it
DIALOGUE_DENSITY: keep dialogue-carrying blocks distributed roughly evenly through the parts that carry dialogue
CharacterStyle: A 34-year-old father wearing a rust-brown corduroy overshirt over a warm beige waffle-knit base layer, paired with dark rolled denim; his 6-year-old daughter stands next to him in an ochre knit woollen jumper and a matching fleece beanie.
Setting: The rain-slicked wooden veranda of a colonial-style Nilgiris heritage homestay at night, with wet terracotta floor tiles reflecting warm amber sconce lights against a background of damp eucalyptus and tea bush terraces.
ReferenceTone: Sharp, clean modern digital capture with deep warm earth tones and ochre lighting; crisp reflections on wet surfaces following Nilgiri rain, balanced with candid, documentary-style warmth.
PhoneShotAction: Held steady and angled directly to the camera, the smartphone display shows the Travafa group voting screen as checkmarks tick up for the morning Toy Train ride and an afternoon tea factory tour, confirming the group's final itinerary choice in real time.
